actions.recordComment: Keep this comment for this visit
actions.copyToDraft: Copy this text to the draft

labels.compareVersion: Version to compare with the initial text
labels.subject: Subject
labels.name: Name
labels.includeIllustration: Include the demo visual in the draft

copy.previewDescription: The text and visual reflect this visit’s draft. This preview lets you review the content before returning to the editor.
copy.proposalOrigin: Example suggestion supplied with the mockup. No AI service is called.
copy.proposedText: Discover our partner’s initiatives and the people helping our community grow. Together, let’s support local projects with OpenG7.
copy.proposalLimits: Review the facts, tone and links. Using this suggestion changes only the local text; it creates no approval.
copy.originalText: Discover our partner and their commitment to community projects, with OpenG7.
copy.compareDescription: This comparison uses demonstration texts. Copying text into the draft leaves the history intact.
copy.commentVisibility: An internal comment concerns dossier follow-up. It is separate from a message to the client.
copy.commentLocal: This comment can be kept in memory for this visit. It will not be saved in a real dossier or added to a log.
copy.commentSaved: Comment kept in memory for this visit.
copy.defaultMessage: Hello, here is the content prepared for your presentation. Please share any corrections or your consent to share the exact text and visual.
copy.noMessage: No message will be sent. The recipient and content are provided only to inspect the journey.
copy.evidenceMeaning: An attachment can document consent or delivery. Having a file does not authorize publication.
copy.fileLocal: The file name and your note stay in memory for this visit. The file itself is not read, uploaded or retained.
copy.receivedMessage: Hello, we have reviewed the proposed presentation. Here is our response and the items to check together before distribution. Please confirm which version is concerned.
copy.receivedDisclaimer: This example message is not real consent. Reading it changes no dossier status.
copy.scope: A website presentation and a Facebook publication are separate services with their own destinations.
copy.duration: Dates and duration must come from the accepted offer. This demonstration creates no commitment.
copy.exactContent: The reviewed text, visual and destination must be identified together before a decision.
copy.contactDescription: Inspect the contact fields and the return journey to the consent request.
copy.contactLocal: The email can be edited in this local form. No real contact record is updated.
copy.scheduleDescription: Choose a time slot to inspect the scheduling interface.
copy.scheduleLocal: These fields remain local to this view. No time slot, task or delivery is scheduled.
copy.resultDescription: This screen shows where to inspect the reference, link and evidence after a real operation. The demonstration generates no provider result.
copy.noEvidence: There is no real delivery evidence in this demonstration.
copy.reconcileDescription: When a response is uncertain, look for the existing result before any new attempt. The form below lets you inspect this step.
copy.noReconciliation: Entered references are not checked. No reconciliation or retry is executed.
copy.attestDescription: A verified absence must describe the destination, time period searched and checks performed.
copy.noAttestation: This presentation form creates no attestation and authorizes no new attempt.
copy.webLocal: Editing updates the local draft. No presentation is saved or made visible on the website.
copy.webEvidenceDescription: Reserved for a page reference, an observation and the observed duration.
copy.socialEvidenceDescription: Reserved for a publication link, a provider reference and qualified evidence.
copy.agreementDescription: Example of reading the promised services in a website + Facebook dossier.
copy.promisedWeb: A partner presentation with text and a visual reviewed in context.
copy.promisedSocial: Publication to the agreed social destination, after applicable authorizations.
copy.offerDisclaimer: These descriptions illustrate the interface. They create or modify no offer or commercial commitment.
copy.checkReason: The journey must let you reread the message, check its scope and locate the content concerned.
copy.checkSource: Attachments and conditions in the demonstration dossier
copy.checkNext: Open consent and inspect the related items.
copy.mediaDescription: The supplied visual is used to inspect the preview. Its selection affects only this demonstration draft.
copy.mediaLocal: Including or removing the visual deletes no file and changes no media library.
copy.filterDescription: The criteria are passed in the demonstration list’s URL.
copy.restoreDescription: Review the initial text before copying it into the editor.
copy.restoreLocal: The copy replaces only the local text. It restores no previous decision and rewrites no history.
copy.leaveDescription: Your draft stays in this demonstration visit. Returning to the dossier saves it in no system.
copy.conflictDescription: Example journey when the remote version differs. Compare the texts or return to your local draft; no server conflict is created.
copy.unavailableDescription: During an outage, keep the dossier context and provide a clear return path. An uncertain command must not be retried automatically.
copy.unavailableLocal: This screen presents an error state. It changes no session and contacts no service.
copy.guideDescription: Three steps to understand the dossier and locate the next intervention.
copy.guideContent: Content: review the text, visual and links; make changes in a single editor.
copy.guideAgreement: Consent: inspect the message, conditions and contact associated with the exact content.
copy.guideDelivery: Publication: review the destination and time slot, then inspect the result and its evidence.
copy.destinationsDescription: Financial facts, the campaign and identity each have their own management space.
copy.paymentReadOnly: Read-only payment fact; no financial changes in this journey.
copy.campaignReadOnly: Funding context reference, separate from editing content.
copy.contactReadOnly: Identity and contact details to inspect before a request.
copy.destinationsLocal: These references give no access to real dossiers. Navigation stays in the demonstration.
copy.confirmationAcknowledgement: I have reviewed this example summary.
copy.confirmationDisabled: Confirmation preview only. This mockup cannot authorize, publish, hide, approve or withdraw an authorization.
copy.correctionDescription: Describe the requested corrections, then inspect the message before it might be sent in a real journey.
copy.agreementRequestDescription: Prepare a request covering the exact text, visual and destination. A request does not constitute consent.

comparison.description: Compare your edits with the last kept draft or a fictional reference. Comparing does not change any content.
comparison.identical: The current content is identical to this reference.
comparison.otherFields: Also compare the link, mention and visual
comparison.exampleNotice: This reference is fictional text supplied with the demonstration. It is not a previous version of your dossier.
comparison.savedNotice: This reference comes from your last local save during this visit. It disappears on reload and is not an administrative history.

restore.description: Review the kept content and your current edits before restoring the local draft.
restore.missing: Keep a draft in the editor first to restore it during this visit.
restore.identical: Your edits already match the last kept draft.
restore.local: Restoring covers text, link, mention, visual and its options. It changes neither notes, timing nor authorization.
restore.done: The kept draft has been restored in memory. You can continue editing it.

confirmation.confirmer-envoi: Review the content, destination and time together before authorizing delivery. Preparing a time slot does not publish anything.
confirmation.confirmer-visibilite: Website presentation visibility is a separate decision from consent and Facebook publication.
confirmation.approuver-preparation: Approval would concern the exact preparation version. It would not make the presentation visible or trigger delivery.
confirmation.annuler-autorisation: Withdrawal would concern a specific delivery authorization. It would delete neither financial facts nor completed publications.
confirmation.confirmer-autorisation: Confirmation must be based on received consent and its scope. An administrative checkbox never creates consent.
